overview: Register (August 1932-April 1933) of correspondence among the Taihoku Consulate, State, War Department, Philippine Governor-General, Tokyo Embassy, and Taiwan's government on Taiwanese fishing-vessel incursions into Philippine waters and efforts to correct the stated northern Philippine boundary.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning Taiwanese fishing vessels in Philippine waters
subfiles.about: This register inventories 1932–1933 correspondence about alleged violations of Philippine territorial waters by fishing vessels registered in Taiwan and the Taiwanese authorities’ regulatory response.
subfiles.summary: Lists Ketcham's 1932 report on new Taiwan regulations expected to curb incursions, subsequent War/State/Philippine/Embassy exchanges, consultations with Taiwan officials, and an April 1933 War Department acknowledgment on correcting Order No. 33 and the Philippine boundary.

interest: Shows a 1932-33 Taiwan-Philippines fishing dispute moving through consular, military, and colonial channels.
